name: digital-human-video-production
title_zh: 从脚本到成片全程可核验的数字人产品视频流水线
tagline_zh: 不再盲等供应商出片。脚本、配音、数字人、实拍素材、动效合成，每一步都有账本可查，预览门控、画中画尺寸实测。
tagline_en: Stop waiting blindly on vendor renders. Script, voice, avatar, captures, motion—every step ledgered.
desc_en: Produce a verified presenter-led product video from a brief, an approved voice master, an avatar or talking-head render, real product captures, and deterministic motion/compositing. Use when asked to plan, generate, revise, render, or QC a digital-human explainer, demo, tutorial, or launch video, including preview-gated provider generation, measured presenter PIP framing, generation-ledger control
why_zh: 它把视频生产拆成可审计的工序，每步都有确定性校验，不是黑盒生成。
why_en: Turns video production into deterministic, auditable stages instead of a black-box generation.
limit_zh: 需要已备好的配音母带、数字人渲染或头像源、真实产品画面；不负责创意脚本撰写，也不替代最终人工审美判断。
limit_en: Requires approved voice master, avatar/talking-head source, real product captures. No scriptwriting or final aesthetic judgment.
title_en: Auditable digital-human product video pipeline from brief.
